## Problem

Describe the concrete problem and its user-visible or reliability impact.

## Change

Describe the smallest coherent solution and any alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] The affected browser flow was checked manually
- [ ] Exactly three static top-level WebMCP tools remain registered
- [ ] Locked assignments remain fixed and blocked wells remain empty after reflow
- [ ] Documentation and measured claims remain accurate

## Risk

Note security, accessibility, compatibility, scientific-claim, or deployment implications. Write `None` only after considering each area.
